profile.name: Otabek Haydarov
profile.title: Software Engineer & Data Analyst
profile.tagline: I turn messy data into clean insights and clean code into great products.

aboutText: I’m a Data Analyst with a solid engineering foundation, focused on turning complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights. While my primary drive is data exploration, dashboarding, and analytics workflows, my background in web development allows me to bridge the gap between backend data pipelines and intuitive interfaces. I care deeply about data integrity, analytical clarity, and delivering metrics that drive confident decisions.

projects.title: Revenue Forecasting Dashboard
projects.description: Built an interactive dashboard that forecasts quarterly revenue using time-series models. Reduced forecast error by 23% compared to the previous spreadsheet-based approach.

projects.title: Customer Churn Pipeline
projects.description: Designed an end-to-end ETL pipeline that ingests 2M+ rows daily, applies a gradient-boosted churn model, and pushes at-risk accounts to the CRM in real time.

projects.title: Analytics Component Library
projects.description: An open-source React component library for embedding charts and KPI cards in any app. 1.2k+ GitHub stars and used by 30+ teams.

projects.title: Natural Language Query Engine
projects.description: A tool that lets non-technical users ask questions in plain English and get SQL results back. Powered by an LLM with a validated SQL-generation guard layer.

projects.title: Realtime Sentiment Tracker
projects.description: Streams tweets and product reviews through a sentiment model and visualizes trends on a live map. Handles 500 events/sec with sub-second latency.

projects.title: Personal Finance Visualizer
projects.description: A web app that categorizes transactions automatically and shows spending breakdowns with interactive charts. Featured on a popular dev showcase.

experience.description: Lead analyst for the growth team. Built the experimentation platform, automated weekly reporting, and partnered with engineering on data quality initiatives.
Developed customer-facing dashboards and internal tools using React and Node.js. Shipped the analytics module used by 10k+ daily active users.
Built and maintained ETL pipelines feeding the risk and compliance teams. Migrated legacy reporting to a modern cloud data stack.
